findings.message: Text at 10px: below the 11px floor for any label or control.
findings.instead: Use 16px body where practical, never below 12px; controls and labels at least 11px.

findings.message: Placeholder content "Acme Inc".
findings.instead: Before you publish, look through every page for placeholder names, emails and dates, and swap in your own.

findings.message: Field whose only label is its placeholder.
findings.instead: Give every field a visible label above it that stays put, like "Email" or "Arrival date".

findings.message: Copyright year 2023 is out of date.
findings.instead: Before you publish, look through every page for placeholder names, emails and dates, and swap in your own.

findings.message: The page has no viewport, description, og:image, favicon.
findings.instead: Set <html lang>, <title>, the viewport meta, a meta description, a favicon and og:image before calling it done.

findings.evidence: heading token: none; body token: none
findings.message: Set a heading (display) font token and a body font token, e.g. --font-display and --font-body, and use them everywhere.
findings.instead: Use free Google Fonts and set a heading (display) token and a body token, then use the tokens everywhere.

findings.message: Animation with no prefers-reduced-motion fallback anywhere in the project.
findings.instead: Put non-essential motion inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), or turn it off under reduce.

findings.evidence: body { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, rgba(124,58,237,.45), transparent 60%), #0b0b12 }
findings.message: Indigo/violet gradient: the default AI palette.
findings.instead: Pick a palette from a real reference style and commit to it; use gradients only where they mean something.

findings.evidence: body { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, rgba(124,58,237,.45), transparent 60%), #0b0b12 }
findings.message: Coloured radial haze over the page.

findings.message: inter is a banned default: choose a pairing under the type rules, or record why the brand mandates it.

findings.message: Quote attributed to "Sarah J.": use a real, named person with permission, or leave it out.
findings.instead: Leave them out until real ones exist, or show real product proof and only real relevant metrics.

findings.message: "Trusted by" strip: only real clients with official logo files.
findings.instead: Only show logos of real clients, using their official files. No clients yet? Leave the strip out.

findings.message: "Submit" does not say what happens: name the action and its object.
findings.instead: Name the action and its object (Save draft, Delete 3 files). Link text should make sense on its own.

findings.message: "Built with React" describes how it was made, not what it does for the reader.
findings.instead: Read every line as a customer would. If it describes how the site was made instead of what you do for them, cut it.

findings.message: "Powered by AI" describes how it was made, not what it does for the reader.

findings.message: 17 different colours typed by hand outside the tokens: keep a palette as tokens.
findings.instead: Keep one radius scale, one type scale and one palette as tokens and use them everywhere. Add a step to a scale on purpose.

findings.message: Pill-shaped button: use straight or subtly rounded corners unless pills are the deliberate shape language.
findings.instead: Reserve pills for small tags; use straight or subtly rounded corners consistently; card radii around 12–16px.

findings.message: transition: all as a reflex: name the properties that change.
findings.instead: Transition only the properties that change.

findings.message: Frosted glass: keep only over rich imagery.
findings.instead: Use blur only over rich imagery; otherwise solid surfaces read better.

findings.message: Text cut off with "…": never cut what people need to read.
findings.instead: Write shorter text that fits, or let each card grow to fit its words. Never cut off the part people need to read.

findings.message: Pulsing status indicator: keep it only if it shows real, changing live data.
findings.instead: Only show a status when it can change and you're showing the real thing. If it's always true, leave it out.

findings.message: The same call to action shown three or more times.
findings.instead: Show the main button once in the nav and once in the hero, and at most two buttons in the hero.

findings.message: 2 em dashes: use commas, colons, parentheses or a new sentence.
findings.instead: Rewrite the sentence with a comma, a colon, brackets or a full stop.

findings.message: Twin buttons: make the second a quiet text link.
findings.instead: One clear main button; make the second option a quiet text link.

findings.message: ", ensuring ..." claims a meaning the sentence never shows: state the result or stop at the fact.
findings.instead: Say the concrete result, or stop at the fact.

findings.message: "serves as": use is, has or does, or name the thing.
findings.instead: Use is, has or does. Name the street or the thing.

findings.message: Sparkles used as the AI badge: name the capability instead.
findings.instead: Pick icons that say something specific to this product, or write the capability in words.

findings.evidence: highlighting the tools that matter most to you today
findings.message: ", highlighting ..." claims a meaning the sentence never shows: state the result or stop at the fact.
findings.instead: Say the concrete result, or stop at the fact.

findings.message: "genuinely understands": show it with a fact rather than announcing it.
findings.instead: Show the quality with a fact or an admission. Give the reason instead of saying a choice was a choice.

findings.message: Numbers that count up on scroll: show the figure plainly, and only if it is real and sourced.
findings.instead: Leave them out until real ones exist, or show real product proof and only real relevant metrics.

findings.message: "Northwind" is a stock sample company name: use the real one or leave it out.
findings.instead: Before you publish, look through every page for placeholder names, emails and dates, and swap in your own.

findings.message: Struck-through price: show a discount only for a real, time-limited offer.
findings.instead: Show the real price plainly; only show a discount badge for a real, time-limited offer.

findings.message: "Most popular": keep only if it is actually the plan most people pick.
findings.instead: Lay out the plans evenly; only highlight one when you actually know it's the one most people pick.
